description_en: Modifies the specification of a subscription Internet NAT gateway by calling the ModifyNatGatewaySpec operation
description_zh: 使用ModifyNatGatewaySpec接口修改预付费公网NAT网关的规格
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-nat-gateway-spec --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --nat-gateway-id ngw-bp1uewa15k4iy57700000 --spec Middle --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyNatGatewaySpec

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Internet NAT gateway.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
公网NAT网关所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Internet NAT gateway whose specification you want to modify
parameters.help_zh: 要修改规格的公网NAT网关的ID
parameters.name: nat_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The specification of the Internet NAT gateway. Valid values:

Small

Middle: medium.

Large
parameters.help_zh:
公网NAT网关的规格，取值：

Small：小型。

Middle：中型。

Large：大型
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment.

true: enables automatic payment. The order is automatically paid.

false (default): disables automatic payment. After the order is generated, complete the payment in the Order Center
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。

true：开启自动付费，自动支付订单。

false（默认值）：不开启自动付费，生成订单后需要到订单中心完成支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
